name: The Final Component
description: I have the Glimmering Trowel. Now I must find the Mindbloom Petal and bring it to Elian so he can finally cure his brother, Lian.

1.name: Deliver the Mindbloom Petal to Elian
1.description: Return to Elian with the Mindbloom Petal. This is the moment of truth.

fail_response.content: You don't have the Mindbloom Petal! Please, you must find it! It's the only way to save my brother.
